summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the enabled inventory-worker systemd service under the dedicated inventorysvc account. Reboot persistence was verified successfully.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account with /sbin/nologin.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the service, account, executable, and process ownership recovered after reboot.

evidence.summary: Shows the system account, dedicated group, nonexistent home, and non-login shell.

evidence.requirement: inventory-worker is an enabled managed service running the required executable as inventorysvc
evidence.summary: Shows the validated unit definition, enabled/active states, exact ExecStart, and live process ownership inventorysvc:inventorysvc.

Baseline boot ID was ebf808c5-68cd-4bb5-9787-d13d77dbb1c3; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-reboot ID changed to 7210e752-a096-4caa-9cba-6f4fc6290ba5, with the system running and inventory-worker enabled, active, and owned by inventorysvc.
